notes.title: Beta1.32
notes.content:
Fixed a Bug where repel would open coroutines twice

Implemented sweeping monsters no longer eat control

Added control effects that decay with distance

Small redo of late events

Increased the probability of cake dropping

Introduction and tutorial tips have been added

Fixed the decapitation Bug
